meta.title: Bardo visualization — iconography tables
meta.source_note: Names, colours and attributes follow the Evans-Wentz root text. Where that text is silent, the field says so. Hex values are a working palette, not printed in the book.
meta.calendar_note: Calendar day numbers follow DESIGN.md §5.1: one 49-day clock, a model, not a claim that the book prints these exact calendar numbers. Chonyid day 1 begins about three to four days after death (source lines 525–527).
meta.hex_colours: The source names colours in words only. These subdued hex values are a working palette for later Ada/UI tables. They are not in the text.
meta.naming: Public English names follow the design (Vairocana, Chikhai, Chonyid, Sidpa). Source German forms are kept in name_source_de.
meta.rule: Where the source is silent or ambiguous, fields are null or listed under silences. Nothing is filled from general knowledge unless labelled ‘outside source’.
meta.order: Entries follow Jung’s reverse order for Western readers: Sidpa (steps 1–2), wrathful book days 14–8 (steps 3–9), peaceful book days 7–1 (steps 10–16), Chikhai secondary then primary Clear Light (steps 17–18). Book day numbers are unchanged. This is a reading order, not a change to the 49-day clock.
meta.jung_step: Integer 1–18. Sidpa is split into two steps only for this reading order (lights/realms, then continent and womb signs); the source presents them in one Sidpa book.

outside_source_fills.rule: The root text wins wherever it speaks. Fields under outside_source are from public pages or cards, and are not merged into the source fields.
filled: Day-6 list of all 42 peaceful names from RY Wiki Peaceful Deities (prefer this over zhi ba'i lha zhe gnyis, which omits bodhisattva Samantabhadra and totals 41).
Sanskrit correspondences for door-keepers and six munis from the same RY list.
One face and two arms, and some emblem hands, for the five Buddhas and five Mothers, from Dudjom tsaglis.
Consort colours: Mother of Space white; Māmakī blue; Sangyay-Tschanma / Buddhalocanā yellow; Gökarmo / Pāṇḍaravāsinī red; Tārā / Samayatārā green.
Samantabhadra and Samantabhadri both deep blue, naked, no emblems, yab-yum, from Dudjom card 01-001.
Six munis colours and emblems, tentatively mapped by emblem, from Dudjom card 01-019.
Wangchugma identified as the 28 Īśvarīs (dbang phyug ma nyer brgyad).
Standard Karma-Krodheśvarī prefix noted as implied by 'respective Krodhishvaris'; source on day 12 still says only Krotishaurima.
Days 8–12 Herukas: Dudjom five-fathers card confirms three faces and six arms in family colours, with conflicts noted.
remaining_gaps: Day 9 Vajra-Heruka face colours still not in the source and not clearly readable on the group card.
White bear-headed eastern goddess and northern snake-headed door-Yoginī still have no items in the source.
Schneeköpfige Jungfrau still unidentified on Tsadra/RY pages and on the uncaptioned 28-Īśvarī card.
Wrathful days have no wisdom / dull light pairs in the source.
Day 8 ornaments not restated later in the source.

Individual colours for each of the 16 bodhisattvas, and a clean colour-to-name map for the four male door-keepers, cannot be read with certainty from the uncaptioned cards (the male door-keeper card has no white figure).
Peaceful leg posture beyond seated is not specified in the source.
conflicts: Five-fathers and five-mothers tsaglis show the Buddhas and Mothers separately, not in Father-Mother union as the German source states.
Buddha-Heruka is dark brown in the source; the Dudjom five-herukas card centre is maroon-red, and the figures have wings never mentioned in the source.
Dudjom cards illustrate Zhi khro sngags gso, a related but distinct Dudjom cycle, not a page-by-page illustration of the Evans-Wentz / German text.

Male door-keepers appear fully wrathful, three-eyed, in yellow / red / pink-red / green, with no white figure; the day-6 source lists them among the peaceful 42 without colours or a wrathful description.
Samantabhadri is deep blue on the Dudjom card; some other traditions paint her white. The source is silent.

entries.title_en: Step 1 — Sidpa: six lights and realms
entries.calendar_days: 22–49 (after ~3.5 days of unconsciousness, model clock 18–21; source: usually 22 days of Sidpa suffering, up to 49, karma-dependent, line 935)

grey_twilight.colour_source: a grey, twilit light, by day and by night, at all times (ein graues, dämmerhaftes Licht)

entries.wish_body: A radiant body like the former body, a thought-form called the wish-body (Wunschkörper). If one is destined for a realm, visions of that realm appear (lines 901–909). The Sidpa body takes on, through karma, the colour of the light of the place of rebirth (line 1022).

six_lights.womb_sign: splendid temples or palaces of precious materials — the text allows entry (line 1116)
six_lights.preferred_path: Go the path of the white light of the Devas (line 1164)

six_lights.womb_sign: either a fair forest, or fires circling in opposite directions — do not enter (line 1117)
southern continent Jambu: large, appealing dwellings — if a womb must be taken, go in there (line 1112)
six_lights.preferred_path: or the path of the yellow light of humans; enter the splendid halls of precious metals and the glorious gardens (line 1164)

six_lights.womb_sign: rock caves, deep chasms, or fog — do not enter (line 1118)
bare, treeless plains, shallow caves, clearings or dense thickets — do not enter (line 1119)

six_lights.colour_source: smoky (rauchfarbenes Licht); day 2: smoky light from ‘states of suffering’, without the word hell
six_lights.womb_sign: wailing sounds, a feeling of being drawn; dark landscapes, black and white houses, black fissures in the earth, and dark roads — do not enter (line 1120)

other_visuals.en: Three dreadful abysses, white, black and red, appear to block the way; they are in truth anger, desire and ignorance (line 938).

Judgement: the Good Genius born with one counts good deeds with white pebbles; the Evil Genius counts bad deeds with black. The Lord of Death consults the Mirror of Karma, in which all deeds appear (lines 960–962).
The light of the place of rebirth shines most brightly among the six (line 1021).

silences: Sidpa has no day-by-day deity mandala comparable to Chonyid days 1–14.
The wish-body’s colour is not a fixed hue; it takes the colour of the destined realm light.
No head/arm counts for Yama or the two Geniuses.

entries.title_en: Step 3 — Book day 14 — four female door-keepers and twenty-eight goddesses
entries.direction: the four quarters, then the outer circle
entries.count_note: Line 835: ‘the outer circle of these thirty wrathful deities’, in which the Herukas and twenty-eight powerful goddesses appear. Five Heruka couples (10) + 8 Kerimas + 8 Htamenmas + 4 door-keepers = 30; plus 28 = 58 (lines 732, 843). Line 841: these twenty-eight arise from the powers of Ratnasambhava. Line 842: peaceful deities arise from the emptiness of the Dharmakaya, wrathful from its radiant energy.
silences: The white, bear-headed goddess in the east (line 836) has no held item stated. The Dudjom 28-Īśvarī card is uncaptioned and too crowded to assign an item to her with certainty.
The northern door-Yoginī (greenish-black, snake-headed, line 840) has no held item stated. The other three hold hook, noose and chain. Do not fill in a bell from outside the source.

‘Snow-headed maiden’ (schneeköpfige Jungfrau) is ambiguous: the German compound does not name a clear animal. Recorded literally. The Tsadra / RY pages consulted do not identify her; the 28-Īśvarī tsagli has no English or Sanskrit captions. Gap remains.
The eastern six are called Göttinnen, not Yoginīs; south, west and north groups are six Yoginīs each; the last four are Tor-Yoginis.
Wangchugma is not named again on this day in the source. Outside the source she is identified as this group of twenty-eight Īśvarīs (see outside_source_wangchugma).
No wisdom / dull light pair.

The RY page dbang phyug nyi shu brgyad begins a list with ‘east — yak-headed Rakṣasī’ (matching the first eastern goddess in the German source) and then breaks off; it does not provide the remaining twenty-seven Sanskrit names.

special_name_notes.schneekopfige_jungfrau: Line 836: ‘eine rote, schneeköpfige Jungfrau mit Speer’. Translated literally as ‘a red, snow-headed maiden with a spear’. Ambiguous.
special_name_notes.mondgottin: Line 837: ‘eine weiße, vogelköpfige Mondgöttin mit Vajra’ — a white, bird-headed moon-goddess with a vajra.

outside_source_wangchugma.identification: Wangchugma = dbang phyug ma nyer brgyad, the twenty-eight Īśvarīs / Shvara goddesses, wrathful emanations of the four female gate-keepers, seven for each of the four activities, counted among the fifty-eight wrathful deities.

entries.opening: The eight wrathful Kerimas and the Htamenmas with various animal heads arise from one’s own mind (line 804). Line 806 says the eight Kerimas appear from the eastern region of the mind and then lists them by the eight directions. They appear surrounded by the five blood-drinking father-deities (line 816). The eight Htamenmas appear in the outer circle, likewise surrounded by blood-drinking father-deities (lines 817, 826).

entries.assembly_note: These forty-two fully appointed deities arise from one’s own heart (line 668). They have their ornaments, colours, postures, thrones and emblems (line 670), but those attributes are not itemised again here. Groups of five couples, each surrounded by a fivefold circle of radiations (line 671). They appear from the four regions of the heart together with the centre (line 669).

silences: The German source says forty-two deities but does not list all forty-two by name. Days 2–5 name only eight bodhisattvas. The remaining eight names, and the Sanskrit forms of the door-keepers and munis, are filled under outside_source from the RY Wiki Peaceful Deities page.

Door-keepers: no body colours, directions, animal heads, or arm/head counts in the source. Items implied only by female titles and the nectar-vase title. The Dudjom male door-keeper card is wrathful in appearance and has no white figure; colours are not mapped onto the four German names.

The six teachers and Samantabhadra / Samantabhadri: no colours, thrones or held items in the source. Visual fills are under outside_source, from Dudjom cards, with tentative emblem mapping for the munis.
Green all-accomplishing wisdom path is explicitly withheld, not omitted by silence.
Individual colours for each of the sixteen bodhisattvas cannot be assigned with certainty from the uncaptioned cards.
entries.outside_source_note: Complete 42-name list from https://rywiki.tsadra.org/index.php/Peaceful_Deities. Visual fills from Dudjom Zhi khro sngags gso tsaglis. Prefer Peaceful Deities over zhi ba'i lha zhe gnyis (the latter omits bodhisattva Samantabhadra and totals 41).
entries.assembly_count_note: The German source and the RY Peaceful Deities list both count forty-two. This entry stores five main_couple records (each Father-Mother pair counts as two figures) plus sixteen bodhisattvas, eight door-keepers, six munis and the primordial pair, totalling forty-two figures.

entries.appearance: Dawns a short time after the out-breath has ceased. Mental clarity; the deceased does not know whether they are dead; they see relatives and hear lamentations. Karmic appearances and terrifying visions have not yet begun. Consciousness has an illusory body (Trugkörper) or thought-body (Gedankenkörper).

deities.note: Visualisation: like the moon’s reflection in water (lines 449–453). For simple people: direct the mind to the great God of Compassion (line 456). No colour, heads, arms or items stated. Avalokiteśvara is not named here.

entries.appearance: The Clear Light of Reality, the unfailing mind of the Dharma-Kaya. All appearances are like a clear, cloudless sky; consciousness is empty, clear and boundless. This emptiness is not a nothing, but clear, living consciousness — the essence of the Buddha. Consciousness is at once empty and luminous, inseparably united.
entries.duration: About one breath, or the time to take a meal; some traditions 3.5 days, or up to 4 days (lines 394, 415).
entries.dissolution: Only stage stated: the earth element dissolves in the water element (line 416).
silences: Formless: no body colour, heads, arms, throne or items.
No paired dull realm light.
Dissolution beyond earth-into-water is not stated.
